name: Summer Arts Intensives and Music Camps (high school)
org: Kennesaw State University, Geer College of the Arts
what_you_do: One-week summer intensives in dance, theater, and arts and design. There are also music camps for jazz band, concert band, piano, choir and orchestra.
grades: Rising 9th grade through rising college freshman
who_can_apply: Students going into 9th grade through college freshmen. The Dance Intensive is for intermediate to advanced dancers.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the main page. Check each program page.
duration: One week for the intensives. Music camps run 3 to 6 days.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 page: registration opens November 1. Music camps: Jazz Band June 13-18, Concert Band June 20-25, Piano June 28-30, Choir July 5-10, Orchestra July 11-16 (year not printed, page is headed Summer 2027). No deadline is listed; spaces fill fast.
how_to_apply: Register on the pages for each program. They are linked from the main page. Sign-up starts November 1. Questions: arts@kennesaw.edu or 470-578-6742.
notes: Not a job. The page states no cost or fee, so check each program page. The Dance, Theatre and Arts and Design intensives list no exact dates on the main page. Scholarships are not mentioned.
